svg.title: Humidity sensor project wiring diagram
svg.desc: System diagram showing 3x AA batteries through TPS63070 buck-boost to ESP32, with BME280 via I2C and Waveshare e-Paper via SPI.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Tell me more about the 3x AA battery pack configuration')
sendPrompt('How does the TPS63070 buck-boost work in this circuit?')
sendPrompt('Which ESP32 GPIO pins are used in this project?')
g.text: SPI: MOSI=23, SCK=18, CS=5, DC=17, RST=16, BUSY=4

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How do I wire the BME280 to the ESP32?')
sendPrompt('How do I wire the Waveshare 2.9-inch e-Paper B to the ESP32?')

svg.text: Dashed lines = 3.3 V power rails from TPS63070 VOUT to each peripheral
